name: Belhaven Bay Caravan & Camping Park
stayType: Caravan and camping park with holiday homes and wigwams
accommodation: Touring and tent pitches, caravan holiday homes (including an easy access unit), wigwam glamping pods and Benston Cottage, a seaside cottage on Edinburgh Road
suitableFor: Campers, motorhome and caravan owners, families and groups wanting simple glamping
parking: Parking on Shore Road, opposite the seaside cottage, for beach access
beachAccess: The seaside cottage is described as a short stroll from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Shower blocks, kitchen area, children's play park, reception, fire pits at the wigwams, easy access holiday home with ramped entrance and wet-room bathroom
overview: Belhaven Bay Caravan & Camping Park sits on Edinburgh Road at West Barns, on the edge of Dunbar and beside Belhaven Bay. It offers touring and tent pitches, caravan holiday homes, wigwams with fire pits and a separate seaside cottage. There is a shower block, a kitchen area and a children's play park on site.
surfTripFit: Pitches and holiday homes right by Belhaven Bay make it easy to check the surf on foot, and the range of options suits van-based trips and groups.
